'''ST-97 "Steel" ''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] the droid was guarding a mine in the [[Jundland]], which was taken over by the pirates, where it was destroyed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individual sent by [[Jundo Martik]] to reclaim the mine.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
ST-97 "Steel" appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the heroic mission "Reap the Whirlwind" on Tatooine.<ref name="SWTOR" />
